# qgsim

`qgsim` provides a small R-facing specification, validation, backend
dispatch, and standardized result layer for breeding-scheme simulation
tools.

Version 0.0.1 includes one pure-R reference backend. It exists to
establish and test the backend contract; it is not intended to be a
scientifically complete breeding simulator.

``` r
library(qgsim)

scheme <- breeding_scheme(
  generations = 3,
  population_size = 100,
  selected_parents = 20,
  offspring_per_mating = 5
)

plan <- qgsim_compile(
  scheme = scheme,
  seed = 123,
  outputs = output_spec(
    populations = TRUE,
    metrics = "mean_breeding_value"
  )
)

result <- qgsim_run(plan, backend = "r_reference")

qgsim_metrics(result)
qgsim_populations(result)
```

The execution flow is deliberately explicit:

``` text
breeding_scheme() -> qgsim_compile() -> qgsim_validate()
                  -> qgsim_run() -> qgsim_result
```

Future backend packages can translate the same validated plan for C++,
Fortran, Python, or Julia implementations while returning the same
result schema.

## Developer examples

Optional, compiler-dependent examples show how a backend can call a
small shared library while preserving the `translate()`, `execute()`,
and `collect()` stages:

- [C++ shared-library
  backend](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/inst/examples/cpp_backend/README.md)
- [Fortran shared-library
  backend](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/inst/examples/fortran_backend/README.md)

These are developer guidance only. They are not installed backends, are
not scientifically complete simulators, and are not required by package
tests.

Collaborators who prefer GitHub Desktop and RStudio can follow the
[GitHub Desktop collaborator
workflow](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/vignettes/articles/github-desktop-workflow.Rmd),
which is also published with the pkgdown articles.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`breeding_scheme()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/breeding_scheme.md)
  : Define a minimal breeding scheme
- [`output_spec()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/output_spec.md)
  : Define requested simulation outputs
- [`qgsim_backend_info()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_backend_info.md)
  : Inspect a registered qgsim backend
- [`qgsim_compile()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_compile.md)
  : Compile a breeding-scheme specification
- [`qgsim_list_backends()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_list_backends.md)
  : List registered qgsim backends
- [`qgsim_metrics()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_metrics.md)
  : Extract standardized simulation metrics
- [`qgsim_populations()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_populations.md)
  : Extract standardized simulated populations
- [`qgsim_register_backend()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_register_backend.md)
  : Register a qgsim simulation backend
- [`qgsim_run()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_run.md)
  : Run a compiled breeding-scheme simulation
- [`qgsim_validate()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/qgsim/reference/qgsim_validate.md)
  : Validate a compiled qgsim plan
